issues.statement: Settings selection checks receipt flags/data but never compares the actual loaded model state with training-receipt.selected_weights_sha256. A different model.pt is accepted and frozen with the unchanged training receipt.

evidence.method: Authorized fictional CPU package plus mocked logits. Change only C model.pt to a new same-shape random state; preserve legal-shaped receipt with original selected state digest; call select_settings. It succeeds and records the replacement file.

issues.impact: Post-training artifact mixups before freeze can give the calibration/final evaluation a different model from the one whose L4/update/resume evidence is cited. Freezing bytes afterwards does not establish that training provenance.
issues.required_resolution: Before selecting settings, verify actual loaded model state_digest equals the matching receipt selected_weights_sha256, validate product/mode and available tokenizer binding as appropriate, and reject mismatches. Keep training evidence and actual bundle bound; add a negative swapped-weight fixture.
issues.scope: This counterexample tests absent binding between two existing fields/artifacts. It does not claim fictional receipt GPU strings authenticate a real training run, and does not allege an actual published bundle was swapped.

issues.statement: The first-start marker is derived only from output filename. The same unchanged settings freeze can be evaluated again by choosing a different output filename, while test_outcomes_observed stays false.

evidence.method: Run evaluate_frozen twice on the same fictional freeze/data/packages, first MOCK-final-a.json then MOCK-final-b.json. Every prediction path is mocked; both complete and write distinct start markers. Same output retry is correctly rejected.

issues.impact: The code promises a first launch for the frozen final test but enforces non-overwrite per output path. It cannot distinguish a previously used freeze from an unseen final test when the output path changes; failures can likewise be bypassed with another filename.
issues.required_resolution: Create an exclusive durable launch record bound to the settings-freeze identity in a shared fixed location, before any heldout prediction, independently of requested output path. Reuse/failure must remain recorded; any explicitly authorized diagnostic rerun needs a distinct status/protocol instead of retaining first-final-test semantics. Add different-output and concurrent/failed-attempt negative checks.
issues.scope: Only mocked synthetic evaluations were repeated here. No actual trained-model heldout outcomes were produced or examined.
